english.title: Fail to queue in order to regulate order / safety on the Transport for London regional railway network
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), while on or near the Transport for London regional railway network at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), failed to comply with a requirement by an authorised person to queue in order to regulate order or safety
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 1(1) and 23 of the Transport for London Railway Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 22 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 24 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 25 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant while on or near the Transport for London regional railway network at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), failed to comply with a requirement by an authorised person to queue in order to regulate order or safety.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
